package.name: react-window
package.purpose: Virtual list for performance with 500+ logs

interface.name: TerminalLogEntry
interface.signature: interface TerminalLogEntry { id: string; timestamp: Date; level: TerminalLogLevel; message: string; data?: unknown; }

interface.name: LogPanel
interface.signature: function LogPanel({ className, collapsed, onToggleCollapse }: LogPanelProps): JSX.Element

constraints.constraint: Use Zustand store pattern with actions for state management
Virtual list for lists >100 items (500 for logs as specified in story)
Use Tailwind CSS v4 with cn() utility for className composition
All user-facing text must use useTranslation hook, both EN and VI required
DO NOT modify files in src/core/, src/auth/, src/services/
Use Inter Mono or Fira Code font for terminal logs
This story ENHANCES existing LogPanel component - do not recreate from scratch

tests.standards: No test framework currently configured (tests directory not found). Manual testing via browser required. Verify functionality through npm run dev and browser console inspection. Focus on visual verification and interaction testing.

ideas.idea: Generate logs of each level and verify color coding and timestamp format
Click clear button and verify all logs removed
Add logs and verify auto-scroll to bottom
Inspect font-family in DevTools, verify monospace
Hover error log, verify copy button appears, click and check clipboard
Generate 600+ logs programmatically, verify smooth scrolling
Click collapse/expand buttons, verify state changes

pattern.name: Color Mapping
pattern.description: levelColors object maps log levels to Tailwind color classes

pattern.name: Auto-scroll
pattern.description: useEffect with scrollRef to auto-scroll on new logs

pattern.name: Store Selector
pattern.description: Use granular selectors to prevent unnecessary re-renders
pattern.code: const logs = useTerminalStore((state) => state.logs); const clear = useTerminalStore((state) => state.clear);

implementationHints.hint: Install react-window first: npm install react-window @types/react-window
Add filter/search state to terminalStore, not component local state (for persistence)
Use useMemo for filtered/searched logs to prevent recalculation
Copy button should only appear on hover (opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100)
Consider debouncing search input (200ms) using existing useDebouncedValue hook if available
Virtual list only needed when logs.length > 500, use conditional rendering
